+# Milestone 1.1 — Named-file counting
+
+## Boundary and delivered result
+
+T-004 reviews the complete named-file counting capability under accepted SPEC R-001 through R-007 and milestone 1.1 PLAN exits, with relevant R-012 checks. Reviewed source is `373203d6f41bee2229eed900b761de8669678e0b` on `phase/1-named-file-utility`, containing T-001 `9dc8075dd1b96d3a2744717a9d6d98a3024acbec`, T-002 `f28f6e415b3e0c13353a61e82354c47b0d2cabb2` and T-003 `373203d6f41bee2229eed900b761de8669678e0b`. Each result/evidence/initial task checkbox is owned by its separate single-ID task commit. All three commits were published and read back before subsequent task work; their uniquely marked maintained issues #2, #3 and #4 are closed/completed. T-004 is uniquely associated with issue #5 and native milestone #1.
+
+Delivered immutable validated TextStats, silent whole-input text and named-file APIs, complete strict UTF-8 acquisition with owned-handle cleanup, exact named-file module output, BOM option, option termination and help. Unit/integration suites are independently discovered and required to be nonempty. The phase remains incomplete: no merge into main, release, next milestone or later phase is authorized by this milestone checkpoint.
+
+## Implementation code review
+
+Read-only review inspected all five product modules, the product runner, unit and integration tests, source docstrings and current README/orientation against accepted SPEC/PLAN/design/layout. Code review is distinct from the test runs below.
+
+| Concern | Inspection result |
+| --- | --- |
+| Value/API contract | Frozen slotted value validates nonnegative integers and excludes bool; fields have value equality. Direct exports/signatures and keyword-only whole-input policy are preserved; imports/calls have no output effects. |
+| Semantics/extension seams | Shared traversal counts only CRLF/CR/LF and preserves terminators. Once-only complete-input BOM normalization precedes normalized counting; Unicode word splitting is independent. Internal seams support future source-independent selection without adding range behavior. |
+| Acquisition/lifetime | Binary context-managed complete read avoids newline translation, strict UTF-8 decode occurs before counting, and owned handles close on read/decode/success paths. Applicable exceptions propagate without partial result or input writes. No fallback decoding or CLI dependency. |
+| CLI/data flow | Argparse validates one named input and handles help before acquisition. BOM policy and `--` termination flow into count_file; only a completed result is printed in exact format. Literal `-` remains a filename. Minimal module entry returns controller status. |
+| Collection and test quality | Independent explicit unit/integration roots exclude workflow fixtures. Actual counts are reported and either zero blocks success; test failure propagates. Real subprocess and temporary-file tests complement narrow portable failure streams; independent literal expected counts anchor core/CLI semantics. |
+| Documentation/scope | Module/function docs and root navigation accurately describe delivered success/API capabilities and planned failure/docs/distribution scope. No governing requirement was changed, no extra API/JSON/stdin/range was added. |
+

Complete R-008 CLI failure diagnostics remain a separately planned milestone 1.2 obligation; their absence is not deferred milestone 1.1 defect acceptance.
